sources.version_or_date: Recipe created 2012-10-18 per original-site search metadata

sources.confirmed: Dynamic property descriptors reject assignment and deletion of existing names, and construction rejects duplicate names and values. Getters return ordinary underlying values, so type isolation and enumeration traversal remain missing.

sources.title: Java 5 enum types and java.lang.Enum
sources.sections_read: Integer-enum problem discussion; Java 5 enum declaration and values iteration
sources.confirmed: Java 5 enumeration types separate named constants from integers and supply all members through values() in declaration order. They can have arbitrary added fields and methods, so immutability of any attached data is a separate design choice.
sources.limits: Transfer to Python requires runtime domain checks and freezing; additional Java enum fields can still be mutable. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C10.json.

sources.title: Ada 95 enumeration and scalar-type semantics
sources.sections_read: Section 3.5.1: distinct literal values, position numbers, ordering, examples
sources.confirmed: Every enumeration literal is a distinct value of its declared type with a distinct position, and order follows declaration positions. A name can be reused in different enum types and resolved using its type context.
sources.limits: Python needs runtime domain checks and storage; Ada's type declaration does not itself provide a Python immutable namespace. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C10.json.
